venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Tuesday 3/10.** Slower night; nicer weather and the extra hour of daylight kept people outside. A few walk-ins asked about garden seating and were accommodated while the sun was up. Josh filled in for Sophia behind the bar with Jada and Elliott; bar top saw most of the action, especially at last call with industry friends. Kitchen: busy for the low traffic, 16% of sales with multi-course tables; cookies 86'd at the end. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Tuesday 3/10.** Nice start and steady flow for a while, petering out at the end. Fun guests: a Ruth who learned about other famous Ruths; Italian winemakers who wanted weird gin and tonics and negronis. Comps $137.55 (4%; industry love, friends, a few DNLs). Top sellers: Jabalina, Material Control, Revenant. Door: SevenRooms launch; slower evening, never held a waitlist; summer-like weather kept folks outside; small 8pm wave of medium groups, slowed 9:30; 8-top walk-in of Italian winemakers; bar mostly empty by midnight; welcomed Seth and Nolan of Bateman's, Sydney (FO Taylor, past EV server), and a Buffalo bar owner in town for a competition. No-shows: Jessica Woldyohannes 2 @ 6:15; Matthew Goldstein 2 @ 8:15 (no feature to charge yet). Kitchen: chill. Note: form shows guest check average $16 and 186 guests alongside net $3,099; verify.
